availability_notes: Repo-tracked records are locally present in the checked repository; this does not confirm remote publication.
Qwen model-quality-v2 raw records and server logs are local-only and Git-ignored in this checkout.
The independent review note records a benign temporary-file-only guarded-edit reproducer; no exact raw stdout file was supplied with that note.
The source inventory and extraction hashes are metadata only; copyrighted article bodies and conversation content are not embedded.
All nine supplied original input files were present at index generation and their byte counts and SHA-256 values matched the retained source manifest.
The selected synthetic E2E bundle contains seven files and ran without a model; it supports integration evidence only, not model performance or observer-overhead claims.

The source checkpoint does not establish an isolated OS boundary, network enforcement, pristine verifier replay, separately controlled private holdout, normalized tool-event stream, or training-data integration.
Observer v1 is limited to the cascade runner and is not total observability; same-user access to observer-owned storage remains unproven.

Targeted WSL2 inventory found 35 local-only top-level files in the three exact Granite/Gemma admission and Granite diagnostic directories listed in wsl_local_raw_artifacts; nested directories were not traversed, contents were not read, and this does not establish public reproducibility or complete run manifests.

The observer probe verified WSL /tmp as ext4. Ubuntu 24.04 is registered under C:\Users\Andre\AppData\Local\wsl; physical media identity and SSD throughput were not measured, and Get-Partition was unavailable in the current shell.

Final validation at source 2a58d61: 286 pytest tests plus 19 subtests, Ruff, compileall, and 41 shell syntax checks passed; typechecking was unavailable. The scoped final independent review was clean.
